title: Send a prepared lesson home
content: For authorised centre staff. Save the learner’s dashboard settings before selecting Send Online. The home lesson uses the saved settings at sending time. A newly sent home lesson replaces older active work for the same learner; completed history remains. Parents should open the currently available assignment. Changes to dashboard settings do not rewrite a lesson already in progress. These source-reviewed changes require compatible centre and parent app builds; ask for app versions if behaviour differs.
